title: Count Alternating Subarrays
summary: Given a binary array, count the number of subarrays where no two adjacent elements are the same.
statement: Given a binary array, count the number of subarrays where no two adjacent elements are the same.
constraints: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100,000; every value is zero or one.
A nonempty contiguous subarray is alternating when every adjacent pair differs.
Return the total number of alternating subarrays.
hints: Track how many alternating subarrays end at the current position.
If the new value differs from the previous one, extend every prior ending subarray and add its singleton; otherwise only the singleton remains.
Update ending and add it to the total.
Each alternating subarray is counted exactly once at its right endpoint.
editorial: Each alternating subarray is counted exactly once at its right endpoint.

tests.explanation: Four singleton subarrays and the initial [0,1] are alternating, totaling five.
Every one of the ten subarrays alternates.
